user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content that may train OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited upon user request or through GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated requests.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content gathered from the public web for model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve web content at users' direction when asking questions.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user-initiated requests in response to a user query.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Public web content indexed to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds info for building Google Search indexes, Discover, Images, Video, and News.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Google Search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: Googlebot-Image.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video-related content for Google Search and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: Googlebot-Video.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: Googlebot-News.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Executes Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: Google-InspectionTool.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible content for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Internal research and development and various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Internal research and development across various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: GoogleOther-Image.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Internal research and development across various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: GoogleOther-Video.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Performs crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents crawl requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training future Gemini models and prompt-time grounding in Gemini apps.
user_agents.scope: Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API for Gemini, and Grounding with Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting User-agent: Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for search and rendering across the Apple ecosystem.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled web content to train generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Secondary user agent that does not crawl; governs data usage for model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in the robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shared content on Meta apps to gather, cache, and display previews.
user_agents.scope: Content of apps or websites shared across Meta platforms like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; might bypass when performing security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed to enhance relevance, accuracy, citations, and linking in Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for improving advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow meta-externalads in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to train foundation AI models or improve products by direct indexing.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training foundation AI models or improving products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow meta-externalagent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches links at user request and evaluates or improves agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links fetched at user request to help AI complete user tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Amazon products, services, and training AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives for Amazonbot in robots.txt or noarchive meta tag.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences across Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Eligible content for Amazon search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives for Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live web information to support user-initiated actions and queries.
user_agents.scope: Live information fetching on a user's behalf; excludes generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide an open dataset for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Automated crawler that fetches a randomly selected subset sample of the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to the opt-out registry.
